# Obsidian Vault Configuration

This repository is intentionally structured so it can be cloned/opened directly as an Obsidian vault.

Start at:

`00_HOME/AWS-Onion - Dashboard.md`

GitHub remains the canonical backup/version-history layer. Obsidian provides the local knowledge graph and navigation layer.

The actual local Obsidian application settings may create additional files under `.obsidian/`. Those UI/workspace-specific files do not need to be the source of truth for AWS knowledge.
